title: Lt. Joseph P. O'Neil's Olympic expeditions, 1885 and 1890
status: IN PROGRESS - snapshot 3 (2026-10-08). SDOC59 quotes below verified against page images (govinfo PDF). Steel Points 1907 quotes being verified next; timeline/members/node mapping to follow.
copyright_policy: No Robert L. Wood text anywhere in this file. Wood's Men, Mules and Mountains (1976) is cited for facts only, restated in our own words. Verbatim quotes only from public-domain primary texts we actually fetched (URL given).

primary_sources_found.what: Report of Lieut. Joseph P. primary_sources_found.public_domain: U.S. government work (17 U.S.C. 105) and published 1896

primary_sources_found.public_domain: published in the U.S. in 1907 (before 1931); copyright long expired
